headline: Recommended final passage of budget transfers for road funding, hydrant fees, and salary negotiations
summary: The committee recommended increasing the annual motor vehicle permit fee funding for road and highway expenditures from $1,000,000 to $2,000,000. It also recommended transfers of $85,100 to cover increased hydrant fees and $10,500 for salary negotiations. Public comment raised questions about a $76,000 street lighting budget transfer.
decisions: Recommended final passage of R-26-053, increasing the annual funding amount from motor vehicle permit fees into the special revenue fund for road and highway expenditures from $1,000,000 to $2,000,000, with Alderman Johnson opposed.

Recommended final passage of R-26-055, transferring $9,100 from Assessing Consulting Services and $76,000 from Street Lighting Electricity, totaling $85,100, into Hydrants-Fire Protection Hydrant Fees, with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Recommended final passage of R-26-056, transferring $10,500 from Citywide Communications Contingency Negotiations to Citywide Communications Salaries and Wages.

decision_evidence.quote: So the motion on the floor is to recommend final passage of R-26-053 to the full Board. MOTION CARRIED (Alderman Johnson in opposition)

MOTION CARRIED (Alderman Johnson in opposition)

RELATIVE TO THE TRANSFER OF $10,500 FROM DEPARTMENT 157 "CITYWIDE COMMUNICATIONS", ACCOUNT 70150 "CONTINGENCY NEGOTIATIONS" TO DEPARTMENT 157 "CITYWIDE COMMUNICATIONS", ACCOUNTING CLASSIFICATION 51 "SALARIES AND WAGES" ... MOTION CARRIED

BUDGET REVIEW COMMITTEE 
 
AUGUST 24, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Budget Review Committee was held Monday, August 24, 2026 at 7:35 p.m. in the Aldermanic Chamber 
and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
Alderman Richard A. Dowd, Chairman, presided. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.
